title: Calf raise

steps.text: Stand facing a wall, or behind a chair, and rest your fingertips on it for balance.
steps.cue: Fingertips on a wall or a chair back.

steps.text: Press through the balls of your feet and lift your heels as high as feels steady.
steps.cue: Lift your heels as high as feels steady.

steps.text: Pause for one breath at the top.
Lower slowly until your heels touch the floor.
steps.cue: Lower slowly until your heels touch.

mistakes: Rolling onto the outside edge of your feet.
Bouncing at the bottom of the movement.
regression: Lift your heels only a little, with both hands on the wall.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your ankles or calves, or you feel unsteady.

anatomy.why: The calf muscles pull on the heel bone to lift you onto the balls of your feet.
